title: Nvidia Lost $2.7 Trillion: Record Sales, Record Crash #Shorts
description:
Nvidia has lost about $2.7 trillion in market value since its October record, and this was its worst week since 2008 (-23%). On Friday, 20 Nov 2026, the stock fell about 12% after Reuters reported - citing two people briefed on the matter - that SEC enforcement staff are examining possible accounting issues. Reuters said it could not establish which practices are under review or when the inquiry began. A media report is not a charge, and no wrongdoing has been established. Three days earlier Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103%.
